concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Count a small collection
concepts.recall: Count each object once

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Join two small groups
concepts.recall: Put the groups together and count

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Take away from a group
concepts.recall: Remove the smaller group and count what remains

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Tens and ones
concepts.recall: Ten ones make one ten

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Add two-digit numbers
concepts.recall: Add ones and tens, making a new ten when needed

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Subtract two-digit numbers
concepts.recall: Subtract ones and tens, trading one ten for ten ones when needed

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Equal groups
concepts.recall: Multiply the number of groups by the number in each group

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Share equally
concepts.recall: Divide into equal groups and count each group

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Name equal parts
concepts.recall: The bottom number counts equal parts and the top counts selected parts

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers
concepts.recall: Line up place values, then add or subtract

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Multiply multi-digit whole numbers
concepts.recall: Break one factor by place value, then add the partial products

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Divide multi-digit whole numbers
concepts.recall: Division undoes multiplication

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Explain equivalent fractions
concepts.recall: Multiply or divide the top and bottom by the same number

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Compare fractions with different denominators
concepts.recall: Compare only after the pieces are the same size
concepts.nonExample: 2/3 is greater than 3/4 because 3 is greater than 4

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Add and subtract fractions with like denominators
concepts.recall: Add the numerators and keep the denominator

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators
concepts.recall: Rewrite both fractions with a common denominator, then add

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Multiply fractions
concepts.recall: Multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Divide a unit fraction by a whole number
concepts.recall: Splitting a unit fraction into n equal parts multiplies the denominator by n

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Describe a ratio
concepts.recall: A ratio compares two quantities by multiplication, not by difference
concepts.example: 3 cups of water for every 1 cup of rice is 3 to 1
concepts.nonExample: 3 cups and 1 cup means a difference of 2, so the ratio is 2

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Solve ratio and rate problems
concepts.recall: Scale both parts of a ratio by the same factor
concepts.example: If 2 tickets cost $6, then 5 tickets cost $15
concepts.nonExample: If 2 tickets cost $6, then 5 tickets cost $9

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Operate on decimals
concepts.recall: Line up the decimal points for addition and subtraction

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Read expressions with variables
concepts.recall: A variable stands for a number you do not know yet
concepts.example: x + 4 means four more than x

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Solve a one-step equation
concepts.recall: Undo the operation that was done to the variable

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Solve a two-step linear equation
concepts.recall: Undo addition or subtraction, then undo multiplication

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Solve percent problems
concepts.recall: Percent means out of 100

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Add and subtract rational numbers
concepts.recall: Direction matters: adding a negative moves left

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Apply integer exponent rules
concepts.recall: Multiplying powers with the same base adds the exponents

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Solve linear equations that need expansion
concepts.recall: Expand parentheses before collecting like terms

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Model a linear function
concepts.recall: A linear function changes by the same amount each step
concepts.example: Start at 2 and add 3 each step: 2, 5, 8, 11

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Add and subtract polynomials
concepts.recall: Combine only the terms that have the same power of x

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Factor a polynomial and name a zero
concepts.recall: A factor gives a value of x that makes the polynomial zero

concepts.subject: math
concepts.title: Solve a quadratic equation
concepts.recall: A quadratic can have two solutions
